correctness.rationale: The oval curvature numerator (1+eta cos3theta)(1+10eta cos3theta)+18eta^2 sin²3theta is positive for eta<1/10. Radius-(1+eta) disk bounds the triangle maximum, attained at exactly six labeled maxima for eta>0. The exact deficit Hessian has two transverse eigenvalues a_eta=(3sqrt3/8)(1+eta)(1+7eta) and longitudinal b_eta=(9sqrt3/4)eta(1+eta); local ellipsoid volume at six points with sampling density (1+eta)/L_eta gives C_eta. When eta=O(eps), localization to two equilateral-circle orbit components and Jacobian sqrt3 yields phase integral mean positive part of 1-s(1-cos3phi), hence F(s). Both asymptotic matches and cusp follow from elementary expansion. Independent SymPy Hessian diagonalization and direct quadrature of F(s) for a grid of phases corroborated identities (max numerical quadrature discrepancy 1.22e-10), not universality.
